title: Solutions Integration Engineer
description:
Job Title: Solutions Integration Engineer/Houston Systems HPC Systems Engineer
Location: 10001 Richmond Ave Houston TX 77042
Duration: 6+ Months

**This is an onsite position, no hybrid opportunity**
Summary:
  • As Solutions Integration Engineer, mission is to support the Geounits, internal users and solutions teams in ensuring the appropriate cloud solution in DELFI is deployed for the customer (internal or external) and adoption is addressed. He/she provides the HQ technical support in order for the field locations to position and deploy the various solutions.
  • Develop the necessary Solution Design capabilities and competencies for ensuring successful deployment of cloud solutions.
  • Continuous knowledge capture on best practices.
  • Technology watch: keeping track of technology trends to improve our Cloud designs and deployments and share knowledge with Solution teams and Engineering.
  • Ensure successful client onboarding to their DELFI environment.
  • Manage Infrastructure and Image Customizations in line with Cloud Adoption processes.
  • Engage with Geo units across the sales cycle to provide technical advisory (client presentations, workshops, deployment assessment, solution design), and contribute to the technical proposal.
  • Identify, Diagnose and Troubleshot complex issues with web applications, backend services and IaaS deployments across Azure, Google and other Cloud Service Providers.
  • Assist in the translation of technical issues and complex problems into non-technical summaries for management up to and including president level.

Specific Work Requirements:
  • A minimum of 5 years’ experience working in a large HPC enterprise environment comprising thousands of servers, large storage solutions, tape and tape automation.
  • Proficient in the installation, configuration and management of Linux based operating systems, preferably using RHEL, CentOS, Rocky Linux.
  • Experience with IBM’s xCAT distributed computing management software.
  • Experience with installation and maintenance of computer hardware including servers, tape drives, robotic tape libraries, GPGPU, SSD, disk arrays.
  • Experience with containerization.
  • Knowledge of networking and datacenter technologies, switching, routing, high-availability, LAN / WAN / WLAN topologies and system configuration for Ethernet, InfiniBand, and Fiber Channel SAN..
  • Experience with HPC Storage Solutions, for example configuration and operation of HPE ClusterStor systems, NetApp, Dell Isilon, and Pure Storage.
  • Ability to write and troubleshoot Bourne, Bash and C Shell, Perl, Python, Ruby and MRTG scripts.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and database installation and support.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform and Azure public clouds. Able to provision and manage instances, build images, write installation scripts.
  • Experience with configuration tools like Ansible and Terraform.
  • Experience with backup and recovery tools, IBM Spectrum, Dell Networker.
  • Good knowledge of Linux security, including configuration of endpoint security tools.
  • Ability to evaluate HPC system environments and make recommendations for improvement in performance and manageability.
  • Ability to investigate, debug and diagnose system level issues.

General Work Requirements:
  • Conform to local change management philosophies, including full testing on non-production systems, prior to production deployment.
  • Effectively communicate all change activities to all affected parties including a clear description of the change, related service outages and possible effects on the different environments we support.
  • Ensure IT deployment standards are maintained, with verification through reporting systems.
  • Meet KPO requirements for InTouch support processing, including full documentation of problem resolution, creation of knowledge content and best practice items.
  • Show a good understanding of computer equipment, and its care and maintenance.
  • Work with other internal support groups, systems, networking, programming, desktop support, computer operations, and facilities as required to complete administration functions.
  • Work with a variety of vendors in technical environments and in the reporting and investigation of system problems.
  • Provide a written weekly status report to the team manager and be prepared to present and discuss this with the team at a weekly status meeting.
  • Prepared to work outside of normal hours as system maintenance often must be performed outside of prime time; provide 24/7 support to computer operations; work with other remote support locations, for example Kuala Lumpur, backing follow the sun support.
  • Participate in support on-call schedule and in weekend power outages, normally two per year and in emergency data center activities.
  • Peer-review all major projects, as part of the normal deployment philosophy.
  • Ensure compliance with all quality assurance, best practice procedures and QHSE requirements, as defined by job position.

Personal Traits:
  • Self-motivated, able to work with minimum direction.
  • Able to work as part of a team, either in small groups, or as part of the Data Center support team as a whole and accomplish this in either a lead or reporting role.
  • Able to demonstrate good written, phone and face to face communication skills when working with a peer group and with internal and external customers and with vendors.
  • Adhere to industry standard systems administration techniques and procedures.
  • Document standard user and operational requirements.
  • Willingness to train others.

Beneficial Experience:
  • Experience with software including Omega2 and Petrel.
  • Experience in Omega2 infrastructure software, OPM, RDM, OSM, OCM, WHSM, MMS, etc.
  • Experience in other software, ECL, IX, Visage, PetroMod.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree from a four-year college in computer science studies or 5-10 years equivalent work experience, and current industry recognized training and certification, for example from Cisco, RedHat or Microsoft.

title: Marine Electrical Engineering Lead
description:
Title: Marine Electrical Engineering Lead
Location: Houston TX
Duration: Fulltime Role
  • Design low and medium-voltage marine electrical power systems to support carbon capture equipment (motors, compressors, pumps, control systems).
  • Develop one-line diagrams, load analyses, protection coordination studies, and grounding/bonding strategies compliant with marine class society rules (ABS, DNV, Lloyd’s).
  • Prepare marine-class-compliant design documentation including electrical load lists, cable schedules, wiring diagrams, interconnection diagrams, and equipment data sheets.
  • Specify electrical equipment (e.g., switchboards, transformers, VFDs, MCCs, UPS systems) for marine environments and ensure compatibility with onboard generation capacity.
  • Coordinate integration of carbon capture power demands with shipboard electrical distribution and propulsion systems.
  • Perform cable sizing, voltage drop, and heat dissipation calculations for new equipment loads.
  • Generate technical specifications, installation work packages, and vendor requirement documents.
  • Support the development of Functional Design Specifications (FDS), Interface Control Documents (ICDs), and Control Philosophy for power system interfaces.
  • Assist our Marine Certification team with class submittals and responses to surveyor comments.
  • Develop pre-commissioning and commissioning plans for carbon capture electrical systems, including energization procedures and FAT/SAT protocols.
  • Coordinate testing and verification requirements with shipyards, EPCs, and OEMs.
  • Support sea trial preparation and post-commissioning troubleshooting of electrical system performance and safety interlocks.
  • Team planning, recruiting, and managing a marine electrical engineering team. Mentor junior engineers and prioritize team tasks and goals in line with department and company goals.

A strong candidate will have the following skills:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Marine Engineering (Electrical).
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in marine electrical engineering, preferably involving newbuild or retrofit projects for commercial ships or offshore vessels.
  • Deep understanding of marine electrical distribution systems (LV and MV), including main switchboards, emergency power systems, and UPS systems.
  • Familiarity with marine codes and standards (e.g., IEC 60092, IEEE 45, SOLAS, ABS, DNV, IMO).
  • Proficient in power system modeling and analysis tools (ETAP, SKM, or similar).
  • Experience with VFDs, motor starting systems, and harmonics analysis in shipboard environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of insulation resistance monitoring, isolation transformers, and EMC/EMI compliance strategies.
  • Comfortable with CAD tools (e.g., AutoCAD Electrical, etc.) and project documentation platforms (e.g., SharePoint, Autodesk Vault, or similar).
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills for working with cross-functional engineering teams, shipyards, and regulatory bodies.
  • Bonus Experience (Preferred but not required):
  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Marine Engineering (Electrical).
  • Experience with power systems supporting process or chemical systems onboard vessels.
  • Previous work on decarbonization technologies (e.g., carbon capture, exhaust gas cleaning, or alternative fuels).
  • Familiarity with integration of marine automation and control systems (e.g., IAS, PLC-based control).

title: CNC Machinist
description:
Job Title : CNC Machinist
Location : Lafyette, IN

  • Perform machining operations including cutting, turning, milling, drilling, tapping, and finishing to tight tolerances.
  • Monitor machine performance, make necessary offsets/adjustments, and conduct basic troubleshooting.

  • Complete routine maintenance on machines and tooling; report issues proactively.
  • Adhere to client safety, environmental, and lean manufacturing standards.
  • Document production data, maintain records, and participate in continuous improvement initiatives
Qualifications
  • High school diploma or GED required; technical or trade certification in machining strongly preferred.
  • Minimum 2–4 years of machinist experience in a high-volume manufacturing environment.
  • Proficiency in reading blueprints, GD&T, and interpreting engineering specifications.
  • Strong experience with CNC programming offsets and G/M codes (Fanuc or Siemens control knowledge is a plus).
  • Skilled in precision measurement and inspection techniques.
  • Knowledge of cutting tools, speeds/feeds, and machining best practices.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional production team.
  • Willingness to work shifts (including nights and weekends as needed).
Desired Attributes
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving ability.
  • Commitment to safety and quality as top priorities.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with experience in lean manufacturing

title: Electrical Engineer III
description:
Job Title: Electrical Engineer III
Location: Lexington, Kentucky , United States
Duration: Direct Hire Full Time Role

JOB SUMMARY:
The Electrical Engineer III position is responsible for the development, integration, and testing of electrical systems to execute the intended goals of specific spaceflight projects and Internal Research And Development (IRAD) projects. Responsibilities of the position include, but are not limited to, serving as the Electrical Engineering functional team representative for specific projects throughout the lifecycle process from concept ideation through return from flight and ensuring that assigned projects adhere to the client’s architecture, processes, and quality standards.

DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Represent the Electrical Engineering team on multiple, interdisciplinary spaceflight projects.
  • Develop/assist with technical design documentation (requirements, diagrams, experiment protocols, etc.) and execute on the project electrical systems accordingly.
  • Implement and verify electrical systems through various tests along the project lifecycle. Develop associated test plans and action plans based on results.
  • Adhere to functional team quality assurance practices to ensure high quality EE products.
  • Serve as the primary electrical engineering representative for spaceflight projects by leading electrical integration and assisting with build, testing, checkout, and quality assurance.
  • Take initiative to coordinate inter-project team communication to solve project issues as they arise.
  • Utilize other functional team members to provide feedback and guidance for project troubleshooting activities when issues arise.
  • Participate in external stakeholder and internal team communication in a professional manner.
  • Identify improvements in standard project electrical systems to improve reliability, usability, and scalability.
  • Lead and/or assist with IRAD projects when assigned.
  • Continually review, learn, and discuss with other team members about applicable NASA safety requirements and regulations that apply to electrical engineering designs for spaceflight projects.
  • Research existing industry electrical engineering platforms that could positively impact current or future company designs.
  • Work closely with the Electrical Engineering functional team and project team(s) to ensure success of assigned projects.
  • Travel to support customer or partner projects and launches.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:
REQUIRED SKILLS:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related technical discipline
  • 4+ years related engineering experience
  • Extensive knowledge of PCB design and development including part selection, interpreting datasheets, analog and digital electronics design, schematic development, complex layout and routing (multi-layer stack-up, thermal management techniques, high speed design, RF and analog layout, etc.) associated fabrication and population, board bring-up and debugging, and quality management
  • Extensive knowledge of firmware skills including embedded C/C++ programming, assembly languages, RTOS, microcontroller architectures, device drivers (sensors, comm modules, storage, actuators, etc.), debugging tools, version control, bootloaders and firmware update mechanisms, and common buses and protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, USB, Ethernet, etc)
  • Extensive knowledge of hands-on hardware integration and testing including sensor selection and interfaces, cable and connector design, electrical safety, system integration (PCBS, sensors, actuators, mechanical interfaces, firmware, etc), and general engineering troubleshooting and verification techniques

PREFERRED SKILLS:
  • 6+ years related engineering experience, 4+ years experience in space industry
  • Master’s degree (or advanced training) in a related technical discipline
  • Experience in spaceflight payload design from concept to implementation in microgravity
  • Knowledge of NASA safety requirements and regulations Interpersonal Skills
  • Manage and track multiple priorities while maintaining a focus towards common project goals
  • Attention to detail and creative and innovative problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment that includes working with changing needs and requirements
  • Ability to lead multiple technical projects and work with Director of Electrical Engineering and Project Managers to determine the urgency of a given task
  • Exceptional project and technical management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both a technical and non-technical audience
  • Motivated for self, functional team, and company success
  • Willingness to teach/learn new skills and techniques to/from both external and internal sources
  • Advocate for collaboration, team-work, integration, and support among team members

title: Mechanical Technician
description:
Job Title: Mechanical Technician
Location: Minot ND 58703
Duration: 12+ Months
Open for non local 12 days ON 2 days OFF -- Shift 7 AM to 06 PM


Summary :
  • The Mechanical Technician is responsible for ensuring on-time delivery of equipment as per operational demands. The Mechanical Technician improves maintenance related nonproductive time ratio of the Product Line's assets within the Maintenance Base (MB) and improves maintenance efficiency and people productivity.

  • Support continuous improvement efforts to improve the efficiency and productivity of Maintenance Technicians.
  • Implement CoSD projects, such as the planned repair and reuse of parts.
  • Participate in failure investigations as assigned.
  • Comply with the TLM Competency Management System.

title: Electrical Engineer - ETO
description:
Job Title: Electrical Engineer – ETO/ Electrical Designer
Location: Houston TX 77056
Duration: 12+ Months

Summary
We are seeking a skilled and motivated an Electrical Designer to join our dynamic team.
Candidates with approximately 10 years of relevant experience can expect compensation at the lower end of the range, while those with 20+ years may qualify for the higher end.
Location: Initially based in Houston, TX for approximately 2-3 months. The position will transition to Sugar Land, TX thereafter.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
DESIGN
  • Application of the current version of the National Electrical Code (NEC).
  • Perform sizing of wire, conduit, and cable tray.
  • Perform voltage drop calculations.
  • Create cable tray / conduit routing layouts, and power plans.
  • Perform fill calculation of cable tray and conduit.
  • Create lighting, grounding, and heat tracing layouts and plans.
  • Perform sizing of overcurrent protection for lighting and low voltage MCCs.
  • Create MCC, Panel board, and heat tracing schedules.
  • Develop 480V one line diagrams and motor control schematics.
  • Perform lighting level calculations.
  • Create electrical bulk material schedule and MTO.
  • Create Substation designs, layouts, and elevation plans.
  • Create transformers yard and bust duct layouts.
  • Integrate electrical equipment layouts and substation into the overall plot plan and 3D model.
  • Create electrical installation details from vendor equipment drawings and documentation.
  • Attend substation fabrication shops, inspect/ verify wiring methods and equipment assembly according to approved drawings and specifications.
  • Attend site surveys of customers’ facilities in preparation of layout and site installation drawings, and/or As-Built drawings.

DRAFTING
  • Create 2D electrical detail drawings and layouts using AutoCAD and AVEVA/E3D.
  • Create To Scale Substation Layouts and elevation drawings using AutoCAD.
  • Integrate substation layouts into the overall plot plan and 3D model.
  • Integrate electrical equipment layouts into the overall plot plan and 3D model.
  • Integrate cable tray layouts and power plans into the overall plot plan and 3D model.
  • Integrate lighting, grounding, and lightning protection into the into the overall plot plan and 3D model.
  • Create 2D installation details and sections.
  • Working experience of 2D detail drawings and drafting standards to complete IFD (Issued for Design), and IFC (Issued for Construction), and As-built drawing packages in accordance with company standard drawing format and procedures.

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS
  • Associate’s degree in engineering or computer Aided Drafting technology or equivalent experience is required.
  • Minimum of 10 years electrical design and drafting experience is required.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, NavisWorks, AVEVA/E3D is required.
  • Experience in design of prefabricated substation and modular equipment is preferred.
  • Experience in an EPC environment is a Plus.
  • Strong computer skills (Microsoft Office Suite).
